text:
emma_cs: Oxbow Therapeutics (trial) pinged — asking for sa-east1 peering + allowlist + header HMAC for a short demo. Can we triage?

ben_ops: Hosted API or Dedicated? Need CIDRs, exact window, and expected QPS.

emma_cs: Hosted. Contact is marta@oxbowthera.com. Window: 2026-09-02 10:00 -> 2026-09-02 18:00 BRT. Sustained ~200 QPS, want demo bursts up to 700 for 2-3 minutes. CIDRs: 18.204.0.0/16 and 2001:0db8:7e55::/48. They want X-OXBOW-SIG HMAC-SHA256 header validation and an echoed X-EDGE-ID for routing confirmation.

rafael_netops: Edge can do v4+v6 allowlist and header validation. HMAC validator is feasible as a short-lived lambda in front of the edge. Recommend auto-revoke and an emergency throttle.

chloe_pm: Renewal chat scheduled in Oct; this demo could move them to Dedicated. Capture latency and token-cost metrics and a short survey after demo.

ben_ops: Risk: 700 burst QPS could spike token burn and cross-tenant cache misses. Proposal: feature-flagged route (ff:oxbow-sa-east), prefix KV caching enabled, and a billing cap of $2,500 for the demo window to avoid surprises. Canary plan 3-step: 2% -> 20% -> 100%.

rafael_netops: Edge config snippet for proxy team: ```
allowlist_ips: ["18.204.0.0/16","2001:0db8:7e55::/48"]
header_hmac: {"header":"X-OXBOW-SIG","algo":"HMAC-SHA256","key_id":"oxbow-demo-2026-09","rotate":"6h"}
echo_headers: ["X-EDGE-ID"]
region_route: "sa-east1"
rate_limit_override: {"sustained_qps":200,"burst_qps":700,"burst_window_sec":180} 
auto_revoke: true
```
We'll need NET-3010 peering ticket and a short maintenance push.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-3010: "Oxbow Therapeutics sa-east1 demo peering + HMAC". Owners: ben_ops, rafael_netops. Calendar event CS-3010-demo scheduled.

ben_ops: I'll draft customer acceptance + data handling consent and confirm they agree to the $2.5k cap and key rotation. Also will add the emergency runbook command: `rb throttle cs-3010 --qps 75` and tag on-call.

rafael_netops: I'll build the lambda HMAC validator and verify we can echo X-EDGE-ID without leaking sensitive info. Revert is a single toggle on the route. Plan: T0 validate CIDRs + consent; T+1 create canary (2%); T+1+2h -> 20% if green; demo start -> 100% for window. Post-window auto-cleanup on 2026-09-03.

chloe_pm: I'll prepare an eval checklist: p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, HMAC failure rate, edge routing correctness, error spikes, and a 3-question customer survey. Attach results to CS-3010 and include notes for renewal.

emma_cs: Assignments acked: emma (customer comms + consent), ben (ops + billing cap), rafael (edge + validator), chloe (eval + renewal). I'll update CS-3010 with contact details and request the demo key. :thumbsup:

ben_ops: Reminder - ask customer to provide key + rotation schedule and confirm they accept the demo billing cap. We'll only keep keys ephemeral and won't store them permanently.

rafael_netops: After demo ends, lambda will rotate/disable key and we'll remove allowlist. Exports: usage snapshot for billing and a short post-mortem to capture any peering egress fees.

emma_cs: Closing loop - once canary passes, we'll request explicit go/no-go from Marta at Oxbow.
